exclusions_not_holding.part: LTC6811-1/-2 (for example LTC6811HG-1#3ZZTRPBF, C459704), two stacked devices
exclusions_not_holding.reason_given: One device measures up to 12 cells. In a two-device stack the upper device needs V+ of 11 to 55 V for TME. With the board's tie it holds 1 to 3 cells or none, so it runs below 11 V or unpowered, with no setting to change that (V181 with V193).
exclusions_not_holding.why_it_fails: The supply argument does not follow. P2's own rank 1 meets V181 through an auxiliary V+ supply that is always present and needs no setting. The same remedy, floating at the split tap, keeps the upper LTC6811 at 11 V or more for any count. The data sheet allows it: absolute maximum V+ to C6 is 50 V and V+ to V- is 75 V, and V+ to C12 is -0.3 V minimum for TME (LTC6811-1/-2 Rev. C, https://www.analog.com/media/en/technical-documentation/data-sheets/LTC6811-1-6811-2.pdf, safari, HTTP 200, read 2026-09-29T03:00:48Z). The stack also passes rule 4. C459704 has stockCount 3761 and canPresaleNumber 3755 (read 2026-09-29T02:58:07Z) against a gate of 50 for 2 per board. It meets V183 with more margin than rank 1: TME +/-2.8 mV at 4.2 V over temperature. The drop may still stand, but on grounds P2 did not give or check. (1) V190 at the split tap: IVP is 0.375 to 0.775 mA per device in REFUP or MEASURE, and IREG(CORE) is 10.7 to 12.3 mA in MEASURE if VREG is taken from V+ through DRIVE. A device powered from a mid tap puts that current on a tap pin, against 100 uA. (2) Each device's V+ to V- absolute maximum is 75 V, against V188's 85 V. (3) The floating supply needs its own barrier under V189. The LTC6804-1/-2 drop rests on the same argument. It stands on rule 4 instead: C581004 LTC6804HG-1#PBF 46/44 (03:00:24Z) and C689540 LTC6804HG-1#3ZZPBF 26/26 (03:00:26Z), both under 50.
